notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Hello all,

Today's patch addresses a number of issues, the primary of which is that when a game is already underway, if a new game is triggered via menus, sometimes the game does not progress beyond the first hole.

There are also a handful of physics tweaks as I work to improve ball behavior, and some minor adjustments to the pars of the various courses.

I am currently investigating an issue where the score panel reports the incorrect score for a particular hole (i.e. a hole that should be 2 under par lists as a par, a par listing as +1, etc.), which sometimes affects the running score on the same hole.

Thanks for your patience as I clear out this remaining issue.

Hope that you're all having a great New Year.

notes.title: Night Falls on The Pumpkin Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone from Serious Tangents!

At long last, Autumn Park Mini Golf now has multi-player capability!  You can host or join public games, or you can create private, invite-only games for your friends.  Your friends will need to accept the invites via the Steam chat system (as is the case with most multi-player games).  These features are currently in testing so if you run into any issues, please report them in the appropriate thread in the community group.

The Pumpkin Patch has also gotten a significant face lift, with a new music soundtrack appropriate for the Halloween season as well as some cosmetic changes to the environment.

To take advantage of the new functionality, please ensure that you're subscribed to the TestingBranch2019 beta (found via the properties panel, beta tab).

Drop on by and play a round or two!  Hope you enjoy your stay in the park.

notes.title: Major Update In The Works...
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been about four years since I published this game. It's kind of hard to wrap my head around that, to be honest.

Since it's release my understanding of game design and programming has expanded quite a bit and the tools available to me have also improved dramatically. That is why I am taking another pass at this game and giving it a much needed update and face lift.

I will not be introducing these changes into the primary depot package for a bit. Instead, I plan to create a new depot-thread, and when I make that live I will be updating in here to ask for feedback from the community.

I realize this is more of a teaser post than anything, but I am working to implement a couple of often-requested features for this game and I wanted to say that although recently my primary focus is on my new VR mini golf game, I haven't forgotten about Autumn Park.

My main reason for putting it off, honestly, was the dramatic amount of redesign work that I knew would have to go into updating the menu system from the Unity version this was initially designed for to the latest version available. But I have a lot more time on my hands now, and this game means a lot to me so I am working to bring it into 2020.

I will be posting additional updates over the next couple of weeks as I work on this. But I thought it'd be nice to wave hello to the people that have already invested in this project and say that yes, I haven't abandoned Autumn Park. Updates are coming, and soon.

Have a great week!

notes.title: Coming Soon: The Pumpkin Patch!
notes.content:
We are finalizing the last few finishing touches for the Pumpkin Patch, a new 18-course mini-golf layout set in the same scenic Autumn Park.

The Pumpkin Patch will include, in addition to a brand new course layout, a new mini-challenge to run your golf ball through ghosts placed on several courses.  We will also expand (at a later date) some additional challenges for trick shots.

Double the game play, with no change in price!  Just in time for Halloween!

Stay tuned!
